specification.methodology: Prepare the complete physical 8x8 pair-count table once; verify all 58 W/T/L rows against independent ordered-board replay and the pinned PR130 report. Before any oracle ranking, complete no-rank 4,000-iteration preflight for all four fixed fixtures. Compare three fresh solves to three reweighted prepared solves per fixture with exact serialized-result parity after removing only equity_preparation. Every measured profile receives independent visible-information replay. Warm calls guard all ranking boundaries. A separate tracemalloc call measures reweight, prepared solve and JSON serialization for the 8x8 stack-24 fixture, excluding source-table preparation, oracle and process RSS.
specification.model_limits: Fixed board 2c3c4d, heads-up finite flop betting followed by forced turn/river checkdown, full hidden future-deck W/T/L integration, four fixed weighted range/config fixtures. No later-street betting, preflop solving, rake, multiway play, unrestricted NLHE or general speed claim.
specification.provenance: New benchmark for the independently implemented immutable fixed-flop equity cache. Independent numeric-rule ordered-board replay and own-hand best responses are used for accuracy checks; a pinned previously published report corroborates physical pair counts. No third-party code or runtime dependencies are included.

vector_upper_bound.loop_entry_scope: Conservative modeled vector-backend validation, aggregation, row setup/normalization, training, and diagnostic loop envelope; not bytecode count, runtime, or process RSS. World enumeration and tree construction use separate existing guards.

source_admission.scope: Logical exact ranking work and grouped output rows; not elapsed time, allocated bytes or RSS.

solver_budget.scope: Full requested training and exact diagnostics, with at most three categorical rows per pair. Source bookkeeping excludes internal hand-ranking instructions; rank calls are independently bounded before ranking. Logical counts are not bytecode, elapsed time, allocation bytes or RSS bounds.

allocation.includes: Reweight, prepared solve and complete JSON serialization.
allocation.excludes: Cached source table, cold source preparation, independent oracle, and process RSS.

timing_scope: Each timed fresh arm includes full source preparation, tree construction, training, diagnostics and JSON serialization. Each prepared arm includes reweighting, tree construction, training, diagnostics and JSON serialization. Three calls per arm are alternated in order; oracle replay is outside timed intervals.
allocation_scope: Separate Python tracemalloc trace around reweighting, prepared solve and JSON serialization for the base 8x8 stack-24 case; excludes cached source counts, cold preparation, independent oracle and RSS.
accuracy_scope: Every fresh and prepared payload is checked by independent ordered-board/best-five numeric-rule replay and own-hand information-set best responses. Exact payload parity is required after removing only equity_preparation from the prepared result. Target is independent NashConv plus 1e-9 at most 0.005 chips; misses are retained.
